flora: Leathery leaflet segment (close-up of parallel-veined, stiff pinnate leaves with rounded tips)
Central seed cone scale (a single thick, triangular armor scale from a reproductive cone)
Trunk leaf scar (macro pattern of interlocking diamond-shaped scars left by fallen fronds)
Emerging fiddlehead frond (a thick, downy-coated young leaf leaf-tip unfurling loosely)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; toy-like density; leaflets must appear rigid, waxy, and thick-edged; emphasize the geometric alignment of the diamond trunk textures; smooth, chunky details.

visual_logic.composition: Tiled layout: Top-Left: a detailed close-up of the stiff parallel veins on a deep green leaflet; Top-Right: a solitary, robust golden-brown cone scale; Bottom-Left: a macro pattern study of the diamond-scarred trunk armor; Bottom-Right: a single thick, downy frond tip unfurling.
visual_logic.ground: A clean surface of weathered basalt gray stone, framing the green and golden-brown botanical details.
visual_logic.lighting: Even, omnidirectional studio light to capture the distinct geometric patterns and waxy leaf surfaces accurately.
